text.brief: A tanker captain off the Horn of Africa hears a drone before he sees it in 2044. The militia that launched it buys guidance chips from a mainland firm and targeting images from a mainland satellite company.
text.record: The Houthis attacked more than 100 merchant ships from November 2023 to mid-2025 and sank four. The State Department said in April 2025 that Chang Guang Satellite Technology supported Houthi attacks, and Treasury sanctioned three mainland firms among 32 targets in a Houthi network in September 2025 ([State Department press briefing, April 17, 2025](https://www.state.gov/briefings/department-press-briefing-april-17-2025); [Treasury press release sb0243](https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/sb0243)). The Houthis told Beijing and Moscow in 2024 that their ships would pass unharmed.
text.reading: The Party arms proxies that fight its rivals' trade while its own ships pass untouched. Each attack carries another's flag and the Party's parts. This is Stratagem 3, kill with a borrowed knife.
text.coreEvent: A proxy force using mainland weapons halts most traffic through a major strait for a month before 2048.
text.gapText: Architecture Governance. Sanctions treat each proxy war as a separate case, and the supplier behind them all goes unnamed.
text.fix: Name the common supplier behind every proxy war and tie the sanctions to it.
